title: Nourishing Mediterranean Dough Flatbread
description: A pungent and bouncy flatbread featuring vegan white wine vinegar and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a light Mediterranean dish
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and salt
In a separate bowl, whisk together the olive oil, white wine vinegar, and warm water
Add the yeast to the wet ingredients and let it sit for 5 minutes
Combine the wet and dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic
Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces
Roll out each piece into a thin circle and bake for 15 minutes
